officialSources.evidence: Fully opened ENSAE Paris doctoral page says doctoral training occurs in IP Paris and Hadamard doctoral schools. It identifies the final title as docteur de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris, with economy, statistics, finance/insurance and sociology as CREST doctoral hosts; no Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering named route on this overview.

Official ENSAE history says it joined Institut Polytechnique de Paris in 2019, and IP Paris is accredited to award master's and doctoral degrees. ENSAE Paris is a member school and exact current school identity, not automatically independent degree awarder.

decision: Preserve imported ENSAE Paris school report as discovery. Do not create a separate currently qualifying ENSAE doctoral provider or rewrite the 2023 individual's awarder. If an exact named Ops/IE doctoral route at ENSAE/IP Paris is found in full doctoral-school fields, add under verified actual awarder/host with explicit relation. IP Paris membership alone and statistical research are insufficient.
limitations: Current IP Paris/Hadamard detailed doctoral-field inventories not fully read; this is not an institution-wide negative census.
Individual 2023 degree and historical awarder require Stage 2 identity/source check, held by owner.
